title: Need help with a complex cutscene im working on.

posts.author: spades141
posts.body: Sorry if this isn't in the right spot. I just need help and a play for tutorials seems like a good place. I got most of the cutscene done. It might not look pretty but the last part of it i cant seem to figure out. I have an ice dragon fly over the camp I made. And I want it to do a ice breath attack. And I know I cant really do that. So I want ice to show up when he flys over the area like it did a ice attack. I have another question abiut my dragon being white then turning brown has it moves. I was thinking it might bc i had it turn from day to night. But not sure. Im new so step by step or something or a video. If u have any questions lmk.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
spades141 said:
And I know I cant really do that.
Click to expand...
What makes you think that? And how do you *know*?
Secondly, there is no "How to make dragon spew ice when flying over camp without it turning brown due to screen tint" Tutorial. Did you test your scene without turning it to night time? Does it still become brown if you do? As per the rules:
READ!!! RPG Maker MZ Support Template
This template will give an idea of what basic support information can help others quickly answer a request.   The more information you provide in the original post, the sooner it can get solved.   A Topical and Meaningful Thread Title  Titles such as “help me” and “it’s broken” are not...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Read carefully and provide additional info that will be needed to let us know what exactly the problem is. You can easily record a video with plenty of free software to chose from and upload it to youtube or something. Because right now, the only thing you're saying "It ain't working", but we don't know what you did, what you've tried that didn't work, what's happening instead, or anything else really.
At face value, the answer to your problem is: Don't tint the screen. And: Use an Ice animation on the screen.
